svg.title: VitraCell Delta State Response evidence boundary
svg.desc: A two-column graphic separating what a synthetic computational study can establish from what still requires biological experiments.
svg.text: A useful stress test is not biological validation.

g.text: • The hypothesis can be expressed as an executable test.
• A single delta is not extra information if baseline
• Identity errors, noise, sampling and validation design
can erase or falsely inflate modeled value.
• The decisive experiment must compare full history
against simpler predictors on held-out groups.
• That real tumor cells contain an informative ΔSR signal.
• That DEP is the best measurement modality.
• That VitraCell predicts resistance or drug response.
• Assay sensitivity, specificity or clinical utility.
• Economic value to pharma or CRO customers.
same identified cell → early measurements → independently observed fate → simpler comparator.
